verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim container tools are available with no setup required and access to the Red Hat registry, plus high-efficiency container creation/management tools bundled in Workstation. However, this is entirely vendor-documentation with no independent/hands-on corroboration confirming zero-setup container usage in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification or hands-on report confirming out-of-the-box container tool functionality, details on which specific tools (e.g., Podman) ship by default.
